newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt first-half sales 681 mln DM.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt first-half sales 681 mln DM.

text.p: German car components group Kolbenschmidt AG said on Wednesday sales in the first half of 1996/97 rose 18 million marks ($10.6 million) to 681 million marks.
Pretax profit in the period rose 3.4 million to 34 million, the company said in a statement.

"For all of business year 1996/97, we expect a moderate sales growth and a definite increase in profits," the company said. "As a result of last year's and this year's investments in new equipment, sales and profits will grow even stronger in the next business year."
Investments in the six months to March 31 rose nine million marks to 57 million marks. The number of employees fell to 7,243, down 145 from March 31, 1996.

Kolbenschmidt last week said its supervisory board approved a merger with the Pierburg AG unit of Rheinmetall Beteiligungs AG. A final agreement due in June was expected to allow Rheinmetall to increase its 25 percent share of Kolbenschmidt to a majority stake.
